improvement: French reported-end-date follow-ups using ‘Lesquels d’entre eux’ or ‘Lesquels parmi eux’ now retain the selected FONGIM, World Bank or EU project identifiers before fresh source retrieval.
reproduced_before: Both French pronoun forms returned no structured resolution and lost the selected project set, while the equivalent English ‘Which of them’ form resolved correctly.

qualification.fresh_retrieval_guard: Only selected source identifiers, a previously established active-only constraint and the newly requested period carry forward. Prior dates, statuses, reach claims and answer facts are excluded.
qualification.period_guard: Explicit years, current-calendar-year wording and bounded rolling periods use the existing validated date logic.
qualification.ambiguity_guard: Unnamed mixed-source rosters, compound periods and analytical additions continue through semantic resolution.
qualification.api_guard: The bounded French pronoun path skips semantic rewriting and invokes exactly one fresh research lookup in the API test.

deployment.blocker: Exact-SHA deployment to the authorised V4 test service requires a signed-in dashboard session. Generic deployment remains unsafe because the configured source branch is older and divergent.
deployment.next_action: Deploy published_code_commit to V4 test only, then live-test both French pronoun forms together with current-year, next-year, explicit-range, mixed-roster, active-only, catalogue, empty-subset, FONGIM selected-ID and geography regressions.

rollback.database: No schema or data change. Retain the existing additive evaluation schema and reviewed source facts.

continuity.do_not_repeat: Do not rebuild the active-only, empty-subset, French catalogue, mixed-source, explicit-range, next-calendar-year, French current-calendar-year or French-pronoun fixes. Reconcile the latest candidate branch and service before exact-SHA deployment.
continuity.if_deployment_still_blocked: Continue the next bounded Q-006 topic-change or supported-time-filter continuity case after reproducing it.

preservation: Accepted PADEL publication, FONGIM selection, geography, source catalogue, response, dossier and account behavior retained; no database, source record, service configuration, access, production or administration change.
limitations: Only recognised reported-end-date follow-up wording and the two unambiguous French pronoun forms use this deterministic path.
Long or truncated rosters, more than twelve identifiers, unnamed mixed-source sets, compound periods and analytical cross-source questions continue through semantic resolution.
No live acceptance, actual-database qualification or full model benchmark was performed.
spending: All qualification was local and made no external model or research calls.
